findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 48 requests to 14 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

4 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: demdex.net (Adobe, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), parsely.com (Parse.ly, analytics), rubiconproject.com (Magnite, advertising).
The main document response did not include a Strict-Transport-Security header.
